fieldValues.title: 3. Status, holds and routing
fieldValues.thinking_reached: The GitHub Project Status field plus label mirrors: 'status: in progress', 'status: in review', 'status: done', ready, promote:ready, blocked, needs-input, parked; wg:* (the working group that holds the problem's domain) and lane:unattended; and eleven gate:* labels in srs and srs-rust (other repos carry only gate:auto-merge and gate:owner-merge). The programme binds the label text to its meaning through label-binding records; the work-status set is clerk#121, the first application of decision f58db200 ('Meaning in the definition over meaning in the surface').
fieldValues.tensions:
- Nine gate:* labels (dispatched, blocked-owner, in-review, working, external-work, pool, session-unit, queued, needs-input) are retired in their label bindings and read by no code, but still exist as labels in srs and srs-rust.
- Only gate:auto-merge and gate:owner-merge are live; they are merge authority, not state (system 8).
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: - Delete the nine retired gate labels, or keep them for history on closed issues?
fieldValues.next_action: Delete the nine retired gate:* labels from srs and srs-rust (quick win, proposed).
